stemMd: What is the logical negation of "Every submitted form is complete"?

options.label: B
options.textMd: At least one submitted form is incomplete.

options.label: C
options.textMd: At least one submitted form is complete.

explanationMd: A universal assertion fails if at least one member does not have the stated property. Thus one incomplete submitted form is sufficient and necessary to falsify the assertion.

distractorRationale.d: An empty set does not falsify the universal statement.
distractorRationale.a: This is stronger than the required counterexample.
distractorRationale.c: This is compatible with every form being complete.
distractorRationale.e: The negation requires only one exception.
